question: Who among the following is known as Tuti-e-Hind?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amir Khusro**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amir Khusro** is famously known as **Tuti-e-Hind**, which means the 'Parrot of India'.
 
• He was a renowned Sufi musician, poet, and scholar in medieval India.
 
• Khusro is credited with enriching Indian culture with his contributions to music and poetry, and he is considered the father of Qawwali music.
 
• He also played a significant role in the development of the ghazal form of poetry in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amir Khusro** was a disciple of Nizamuddin Auliya, one of the most famous Sufi saints of the Chishti Order.
 
• He was born in 1253 in Patiyali, in present-day Uttar Pradesh, India, and died in 1325.
 
• Khusro served as a court poet to several Delhi Sultans, including Alauddin Khalji and Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq.
 
• His works include a rich collection of poetry in Persian and Hindavi, and he authored several prose works as well.
 
• Amir Khusro's legacy continues to influence Indian classical music and literature to this day.
